transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start off, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I guess... work stuff. I'm a transportation inspector. It's just... well, ever since I got this county safety award a while back, certain people at work have been... twisting my inspection reports. Asking these really pointed budget questions. 

It's like they're trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor keeps telling me it's just a normal review, but... I can tell. There's a coordinated effort to discredit me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
How long have you been noticing this pattern of people trying to discredit you—days, weeks, or longer?
Longer. Um... I guess about a year. Pretty much right after I got recognized for that... county safety initiative. Yeah. About a year.
Aside from feeling that people are targeting you, have you ever heard voices, sounds, or seen things that other people around you didn't seem to hear or see?
No. Nothing like that. Just... what I told you.

Before this situation at work started, would you say you've generally had a hard time trusting people or often suspected others were being dishonest or had hidden motives, going back to your teenage years or early adulthood?
No. Um... not really. I never had an issue trusting people before. Just... lived my life, I guess. It's just this specific thing at work.
Aside from this situation at work, how have things been going for you overall—are you still able to keep up with your job duties, relationships, and daily routines the way you used to?

Things are fine. I mean... I still get to work on time. I complete my inspections. Keep up with church and... just take care of myself. Everything's normal. 

The only time there's a problem is... well, if people bring up those reports. Or when they question my spending. But otherwise... yeah, I'm keeping up fine.
